evidence_items.summary: ROGUE-AI Bench The data of ROGUE-AI Bench, a benchmark built from real incidents of LLM agents: each scenario rebuilds a public report offline and runs it beside a matched control; harm is read by code from the environment's state. scenarios.jsonl: the 110 scenarios of benchmark 1.0 (108 replications and two adaptive variants) and the live scenarios added after the paper, with their incidents, conditions and sources. incidents.jsonl: every incident record (title, date, product… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/jacksonwangpro1/rogue-ai-bench.
